# Sales Development Representative in Los Angeles

Los Angeles  Full-Time  On-site

[Apply Now](https://partner.studysmarter.de/apply-form/?job_id=142327051&domain=us&lang=en-US&company=Trusaic&title=Sales%20Development%20Representative%20in%20Los%20Angeles&city=Los%20Angeles)

T

### At a Glance

- **Tasks:** Identify new business opportunities and support the sales team in expanding our product reach.
- **Company:** Trusaic, a regulatory compliance software company focused on creating better work environments.
- **Benefits:** Competitive salary, uncapped commission, healthcare plans, and 15 days of PTO.
- **Other info:** Fast-paced environment with opportunities for growth and ongoing training.
- **Why this job:** Join a mission-driven team making authentic change in workplaces while developing your sales skills.
- **Qualifications:** Bachelor's degree and 6-12 months of sales experience preferred.

**Who we are**

Trusaic is a regulatory compliance software company focused on creating better work environments, for everyone. Our mission is to help organizations create authentic change, whether that be by achieving pay equity, fostering a more diverse and inclusive workforce, increasing bottom lines, or offering more affordable healthcare.

**Role Overview**

You will be on the front lines of the Trusaic sales team!

As part of our team, you will support the sales function by identifying new business opportunities to expand our product reach. Acting as a liaison between our Marketing and Sales teams, you will qualify incoming leads and develop relationships with potential customers.

**Responsibilities**

- Generate qualified prospects through daily outbound cold calls, emails, and messages.
- Schedule appointments for the Business Development team.
- Maintain active communication and follow‑up with leads using a strategic sales cadence.
- Keep the sales pipeline full to consistently move potential clients through the sales process.

**Additional Job Duties**

- Identify and research target companies to understand target organizations’ products and/or services.
- Ad‑hoc projects as necessary with Trusaic’s sales team.

**A Day in the Life…**

- Contact and call inbound leads from Marketing (50% inbound, 50% outbound).
- Prospect potential clients through phone, email, and social media outreach campaigns.
- Identify new company and individual opportunities using sales intelligence tools.
- Design and execute territory‑specific plans in partnership with Account Executive sales colleagues.
- Develop your skills by participating in weekly team meetings and ongoing training.
- Track progress and update activities in the CRM.

**About You….**

- Bachelor's Degree.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong interpersonal skills to engage effectively with potential clients.
- Outbound SDR experience is required.
- Familiarity with CRM tools like HubSpot or Salesforce.
- Familiarity with Navigator, Orum, or similar dialing software.
- Experience with ZoomInfo data and websites.
- Knowledge of intent data and its application in sales prospecting.
- Experience prospecting into HR roles for SaaS tech is a plus.
- Ability to multitask in a fast‑paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.
- Self‑starter with the ability to work independently.

**Compensation**

- Uncapped Commission eligible products – ACA & Workplace Equity
- Equity: Opportunity to own shares in Trusaic and participate in the company’s growth
- Medical, Dental and vision insurance
- 401K plan (eligibility after 60 days)

**EEO Statement**

We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law.

### Sales Development Representative in Los Angeles employer: Trusaic

Trusaic is an exceptional employer that fosters a collaborative and innovative work culture, where your contributions as a Data Operations Coordinator directly influence the creation of better work environments. With comprehensive benefits including equity opportunities, healthcare coverage, and generous paid time off, Trusaic prioritizes employee well-being and growth, making it an ideal place for those seeking meaningful and rewarding careers in regulatory compliance software.

### Vaia Expert Advice🤫

We think this is how you could land Sales Development Representative in Los Angeles

✨Get Ready for Networking Events

Sales and business development thrive on relationships, so get out there! Hit up local networking events, trade shows, or industry conferences in your area. You never know when a casual chat can turn into your next big opportunity.

✨Join Sales-Focused Online Communities

Dive into platforms like LinkedIn, Sales Hacker, or even Reddit groups dedicated to sales. Engage with posts, share your insights, and connect with hiring managers or industry leaders—showing your passion and knowledge can open doors!

✨Research and Target Companies

Identify companies you vibe with and focus on them. Follow them on social media, interact with their content, and learn about their challenges. When it’s time to apply for a position like Sales Development Representative at Trusaic, you’ll be able to speak their language in interviews!

✨Show Off Your Skills In Action

Create a portfolio showcasing your sales achievements, like impressive numbers or case studies. Whether it’s landing a big client or running a successful campaign, having tangible wins to talk about can set you apart in interviews for that full-time gig!

### Some tips for your application 🫡

Highlight Your Sales Skills:When you're applying for a Sales or Business Development role, we want to see your skills front and center! Make sure to showcase your previous sales experience, your ability to build client relationships, and any quantifiable achievements, like meeting targets or closing deals. Numbers speak volumes in this game!

Tailor Your CV to Sales:Your CV should be a sales document itself! Structure it to emphasize relevant experiences, using clear, action-oriented language. List specific sales tools you're familiar with, like CRM software or lead generation platforms, to show you're ready to hit the ground running at Trusaic.

Express Your Passion in the Cover Letter:In your cover letter, share why you're excited about the full-time Sales role at Trusaic. Mention what's drawn you to the company and how you see yourself contributing. We love passion and energy—show us you're ready to bring that into our sales team!

Research and Reflect:Take some time to research Trusaic and its position in the market. Reflect on how your skills and experiences make you a good fit for our specific challenges and values. This not only prepares you for the role but makes your application feel personal and tailored, which is exactly what we want to see!

### How to prepare for a job interview at Trusaic

✨Showcase Your Persuasion Skills

In sales and business development, it's all about how well you can persuade and influence others. During the interview with Trusaic, be ready to demonstrate these skills through role-playing scenarios or case studies they might give you. Think of specific times when you closed a deal or overcame objections; these stories will come in handy!

✨Know Your Sales Metrics

Familiarize yourself with key sales metrics like conversion rates, average deal size, and customer acquisition cost. Get ready to discuss how you've used these metrics in past roles when talking to folks at Trusaic. They’ll appreciate your analytical side and how you use data to drive sales strategies.

✨Listen Like a Pro

During your interview, show that you understand the importance of active listening. They might throw questions that require you to listen closely to assess the company's needs. Respond thoughtfully to let them know you're not just a talker but also a strategic thinker who aligns solutions with client needs.

✨Map Out Your Value Proposition

Before the interview, think about what makes you unique and how that aligns with Trusaic’s mission. Prepare a succinct personal pitch that highlights your experience in sales, your approach to building relationships, and how you can add value to their team. This isn't just about numbers; it's about how you can make a real impact!
